ideas.pitch: A desktop utility that interfaces with MSI hardware sensors via proprietary telemetry to dynamically optimize cooling and performance profiles using lightweight ML inference.
ideas.title: MSI Hardware-Integrated Thermal AI Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the MSI sponsor stall and technical presence at the venue, appealing to hardware judges who want to see software leverage their specific ecosystem.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and AI-powered dashboard tailored for institutional campuses like KPRIET to forecast energy consumption peaks and recommend automated load-shedding strategies.
ideas.title: Campus GreenNovation Energy Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning pattern of multi-agent RAG forecasting seen in the GreenNovation hackathons, applied locally to the host college's infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: A geo-spatial monitoring platform that uses open satellite imagery and computer vision to flag unauthorized industrial land use or environmental violations near Coimbatore.
ideas.title: LitzTech Industrial Compliance Satellite Viewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with technical priorities from LitzTech and mirrors the technical depth of the Xcelerate satellite monitoring winning project.

ideas.pitch: A graph-intelligence based anomaly detection dashboard designed to monitor and score digital transaction risks for campus-run cooperative stores and student events.
ideas.title: WYNTRIX Smart Campus AML & Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to technical sponsor WYNTRIX by deploying graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models similar to the Bito AML platform.

ideas.pitch: An automated dietary planning and food waste reduction platform that uses generative AI to map hostel mess weekly menus against individual student health metrics.
ideas.title: KPRIET Mess AI Nutrition Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Localized specifically for the KPRIET student body, making the demo instantly relatable and engaging for local judges and faculty members.
